verdict.rationale: Box's own docs point to a free developer account that can generate a token and make real API calls against the same API (box-docs-31, box-docs-17). Community reports confirm a free consumer tier with file-size and bandwidth limits, used with the regular desktop client (box-comm-2, box-comm-5, box-comm-6), but no first-party evidence publishes the free tier's storage quota. Missing for 10: a first-party published free-tier storage quota, official confirmation that free accounts use the same desktop/mobile clients, current (non-dated) corroboration of free-tier limits.
